title: stelis duquei
intro: Stelis duquei, commonly known as the "forest orchid," is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family. This plant is traditionally used in medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Stelis duquei include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic activities, which can aid in wound healing and protecting against oxidative stress. However, further research is needed to confirm the bioactive constituents responsible for these effects, although some studies suggest the presence of flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds.
